description: Gives half the frame to an image or clip and keeps the speaker in the other half, punching the camera into the speaker's side so they are not cropped oddly.

fields.name: asset
fields.label: Panel media
fields.description: Image shown on the panel side. Use the clip field for video.

fields.name: clip
fields.label: Panel clip
fields.description: Optional video for the panel side; takes priority over the image.

fields.name: side
fields.label: Panel side
fields.description: Which half of the frame the panel occupies.

fields.name: rect
fields.label: Speaker framing
fields.description: How the camera frames the speaker in the half they keep.

fields.name: volume
fields.label: Panel clip volume
fields.description: Volume of the panel clip's own audio, 0 to 1.
